artworks.title: The Kiss Returned
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, watercolor, and gouache
artworks.creditLine: Samuel H. Kress Collection

artworks.title: Port Scene
artworks.creditLine: Samuel H. Kress Collection
artworks.description: This image depicts an archway under a large stone tower structure, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The scene descends towards a dock area. The horizon is obscured by the towering structures, but the dock scene with sailing ships can be seen in the distance through the archway. The brushstrokes create a textured effect on the stone surfaces and figures. The color palette is muted, with grays, blues, and earthy tones. Close to us, people are gathered on steps, some seated on what appear to be large sacks or bundles, while others are moving or interacting. Further back, beyond the archway, boats are visible, populated with figures engaged in activity, creating a lively harbor scene.

artworks.title: Three Studies of a Woman's Head and a Study of Hands [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk and graphite with black chalk and pink wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Samuel H. Kress Collection
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting three women's upper bodies in various orientations across the composition. Each woman has distinct facial features, including rounded cheeks and subtle lips. Their hair is styled with gentle curls framing their faces. They are shown wearing draped clothing typical of an artistic study. Two hands are drawn touching intricately in the center of the composition. There are no defined background elements in the sketch.

artworks.title: View of a House, a Cottage, and Two Figures [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Samuel H. Kress Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a slightly elevated point of view, providing a full perspective. The horizon is not clearly defined, with the roof lines and trees indicating a settled landscape in the distance. The drawing uses delicate brushstrokes to convey texture and form in a sepia color palette. In the foreground, there are haystacks and a shelter with two figures. To the left, there is a building with a sloping roof and trees. The sky above has faintly drawn clouds.

artworks.title: The Lute Player
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David Rust
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person seated in a three-quarter view turned to the side, with their upper body twisting slightly toward the viewer. The person has curly hair, while their facial features are delicately sketched. The individual is dressed in a flowing garment, and they hold a musical instrument. The background is plain and unadorned, with brown-toned shading and subtle texture.

artworks.title: Fishing Boats Along Quay, Noank, Conn.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows sailboats docked along a wooden pier in a harbor. Two weathered wooden buildings are on the right side near the water. The horizon is low, with boat masts reaching upwards. The style features etching strokes giving texture to water, reflections, and structures in a monochromatic color palette. A small rocky shoreline is seen in the distance.

artworks.title: The Rialto, Venice
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image features a canal scene with a focus on an arch bridge across the water. The perspective is from the canal's edge, facing the bridge. There are figures on the bridge and moored boats near the viewer. The artwork is done with fine, detailed brushstrokes resembling an etching style. The colors are sepia tones, and the background shows city structures.

artworks.title: Whistler's House, Old Chelsea
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image is a detailed etching of a waterfront scene captured from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is just above the row of buildings lining the water. The scene shows several figures engaged in various activities on the left, with rooflines and chimneys spearing the skyline against a softly cloudy sky. In the distance to the right, a bridge extends across the water. The artist uses fine, delicate lines to render the architecture and figures with precision, making rowboats and barges appear motionless on calm waters. The overall palette is monochrome, emphasizing detailed line work and offering a classic, timeless atmosphere to the scene.

artworks.title: Eight Bells
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.

artworks.title: Fog Warning
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.

artworks.title: Mending Nets
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: Two women are depicted in a seated position in this detailed drawing. Both women are visible in full body as they sit closely together. The woman on the right appears to be seated on a wooden stool, holding a piece of string in her left hand, while the other woman is sitting on the ground, holding a fishing net. Both women have their heads slightly bent forward as they focus on their task. The woman on the right has long, wavy hair that falls over her shoulders, while the other woman has her hair pulled back. They are wearing simple dresses with long skirts that reach just above their bare feet. The background shows a serene view of the sea with a sailboat faintly visible towards the horizon. The drawing is characterized by fine, delicate lines, giving it a subtle and textured appearance.

artworks.title: Saved
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on a sling over rough water. The person's face is tilted upwards, with closed eyes and wet hair. They wear a long, clinging dress. There are crashing waves and rocks visible in the background.

artworks.title: Sunday after Christmas 1848
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cartoon-like composition with handwritten text. The drawing features a simple line sketch of a figure wearing a coat, holding up a book in one hand. There is an accompanying sketch of smaller stick figures to the right. Above the figure, text is written in a cursive style that states, "This little book is rather over than all the good any time!" The main sketch is signed "W Homer age 12" with "Sunday after Christmas 1848" noted beside it. Below is writing addressed to "Dear Mother," dated Dec. 27, 1868.

artworks.title: Seated Female Nude
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's upper body seated with their right arm resting to the side. The face is depicted with calm expression and wavy hair framing it. The individual is depicted nude without any accessories. The background has diagonal pencil strokes adding texture to the composition.

artworks.title: Dooryard, Buckets and Tree
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated viewpoint of a rustic building with a tree nearby. The structure’s roofs dominate the scene without showing the horizon. The artist used fine, linear etching lines to depict the wooden boards, shingles, and tree foliage. The monochromatic color palette creates a contrast-rich, dramatic effect. In the foreground, there is a tree and a table with some objects. In the distance, the roof and part of the building's exterior are visible with detailed cross-hatching to show shadows and lighting.

artworks.title: Mother and Child
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, holding a baby in her arms. The woman is depicted in a sketching style, with her hair tied up, wearing a long dress. The setting appears to be indoors, with a furniture piece in the background.

artworks.title: Arcturus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body etching of a young male figure standing on a circular platform. The boy is depicted nude, with his hands raised to his neck, holding a curved staff. His head is slightly tilted to the side, eyes closed in a serene expression, and his hair is short and curly. Flowing ribbons or draperies surround him, adding to the dynamic quality of the composition. In the background, there are star-like shapes, adding a mystical element to the piece. The setting is largely abstract, with the ribbons and staff providing the main physical context in an otherwise neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Young Girl with Large Hat
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image displays a full-length sketch of a young girl standing confidently. She is leaning slightly to one side with one hand on her hip and the other holding a garment over her shoulder. The girl has short, wavy hair and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat. She is dressed in a loose, flowing dress with puffy sleeves, and what appears to be boots or high socks. The background features vertical paneling, and the drawing is surrounded by a plain paper border with handwritten notes at the bottom.

artworks.title: The 'Adam and Eve', Old Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian laid paper backed with  Asian wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image displays a waterfront scene illustrated in a pen-and-ink style. The point of view is slightly elevated, looking towards a row of buildings lining the water's edge. The buildings dominate the right and middle section, while docked boats are visible on the left and bottom. The horizon line is suggested where the buildings meet the sky. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes, capturing the textures of the boats, water, and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic with various sepia shades, giving it a vintage appearance. In the distance, several chimneys extend into the sky.

artworks.title: Bibi Valentin
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a child reclining in a seated position with legs straight out. The child's head is turned slightly towards the viewer, revealing a round face with prominent eyes and tousled hair. They are dressed in a loose garment and resting one hand on the ground. In the lower area, there is a signature "Whistler 1859." The background has sketch-like lines with a textured surface.

artworks.title: Reading (Mr. and Mrs. Ch. Deering)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.

artworks.title: Ernest Renan
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts a black and white sketch of a person's upper body. The individual is seated, leaning back with their head turned to the right against the high back of a chair or sofa. They have a contemplative expression with prominent facial features, including deep-set eyes and a slightly opened mouth. The person has medium-length, tousled hair covering their ears, and is dressed in dark clothing, possibly a suit jacket. Various indistinct forms and lines around them suggest a cluttered environment, potentially books or papers. Faint outlines in the background hint at bookshelves or architectural details, adding to the textured setting.

artworks.title: Cardinal Manning, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. George Matthew Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a side profile of an elderly man's head and shoulders. He is facing to the left with his head upright, featuring a prominent nose, deeply set eyes, thin lips, pronounced cheekbones, thinning hair, and a small cap. The man wears a simple garment with fine details, against a plain background.

artworks.title: The Hand of the Artist's Daughter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. George Matthew Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hand resting on a surface. The drawing depicts a hand with the palm facing downward, fingers gently curved around the edge of a flat surface or object. The pencil rendering uses shading to capture the contours and texture of the skin, giving the hand a three-dimensional appearance. The background is minimal, focusing attention solely on the hand. The initials "A.L." can be seen on the paper. The overall effect emphasizes realism and the skilled use of light and shadow.
